storage_limits.finite_budget_accounting: state/incoming/objects/quarantine and planned staging; measured receiver state bytes reported separately from working tree

reset.fault: dedicated QEMU VM: abrupt cache-discard/reboot matrix or explicitly selected actual disk exhaustion
reset.disk: new raw ext4 image, virtio-blk cache=none; host storage remains running
reset.limitations: Guest dirty caches lost; no physical power loss, host cache loss or Pi hardware claim

measurement_limits: TLS/TCP stream bytes include both directions, HTTP/TLS records and handshakes; IP/TCP/SSH/VPN headers excluded
Warm filesystem caches; fresh application stores per repetition; validation shares the workstation
Full-size campaign one sample; repeated smaller campaign three samples; observed ranges, no p99 or statistical tail claim
Proxy delay is per 64-KiB read, not calibrated RTT; throttling in these runs is per response TCP stream, not an aggregate link cap
Baseline hashes and flushes working files but retains no immutable history; algorithms perform different storage/metadata work
CPU/FD/RSS samples cover File Sync receiver process; baseline CPU and RSS not instrumented
VPS-route comparator stores locally and routes through two SSH forwarding channels via the actual VPS; native VPS storage verified separately
Final campaign overlapped workstation space pressure and owner-requested inactive-fixture cleanup; timings are shared-host observations
remaining_acceptance: actual owner normal edits, offline/reconnect, restart and measured duration
owner product/causal/recovery/GC/bottleneck explanation without agent assistance
validation_roots: Recorded paths are provenance; nonessential fixtures were removed after owner-authorized marker/process/service checks
